what: SessionStart injection configurability — three settings that control what/how-much lands in SessionStart context (2026-04-22, pending implementation in upcoming bundle). (1) `injection.maxChars` (default 1200) — overall character cap applied AFTER all layer-specific limits combine; currently hard-coded as MAX_INJECT_CHARS constant in handlers.ts:481. Truncation appends '\n...truncated'. Users who want richer context bump to 2000+; token-sensitive users drop to 600. (2) `injection.preferences.excludeScoped` (default false) — when true, SessionStart skips preferences with a non-null scope (they still surface via Read/Edit path hooks). Default false preserves current "inject all prefs regardless of scope" behavior which matters because most user preferences tend to be scoped in practice. (3) `recall.focusedScopeMinSegments` (default 2) — minimum fixed-prefix segments for a scope to match descendants at arbitrary depth in focused mode. Fixes the gap where `src/api/**`-scoped memories don't surface for `src/api/routes/routeA.ts` under current hard-coded focused-mode. Setting to 1 restores current behavior. Re-introduces configurability lost when `recall.minScopeDepth` was removed in fe809b3 as "dead" — that removal was Chesterton's-fence wrong: the config appeared unused only because computeScopedForPath stopped reading it and hard-coded the logic, not because the capability was gone.
why: Decisions locked in for the 15-change remediation bundle. The default values matter — `excludeScoped=false` and `focusedScopeMinSegments=2` together produce the intuitive user experience (prefs surface everywhere they're relevant, deep files see mid-scoped mems). maxChars=1200 preserves current behavior while unblocking users who want bigger injection.
